name: Trip lock
summary: A trip card with seats that fill as people commit; it locks once enough are in.
useWhen: a trip or plan that only happens if enough people commit
'senior trip or never', 'need 4 to book the Airbnb', 'who's actually in for Nashville'
dontUseWhen: a simple yes or no RSVP with no minimum (use an RSVP)
splitting the cost (use a bill split)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Senior yr or never'

sub.description: Airline and size line, e.g. 'Muse Air · trip for 6'

date.description: Event date in sentence case, e.g. 'Fri, Mar 13 at 8:00 AM'

from.description: Where the trip leaves from, e.g. 'Campus'

to.description: Where the trip is going, e.g. 'Nashville'

details.description: Dates, fare and meeting place, e.g. 'Mar 13–16 · ~$140 each · gate: the chat'

deadline.description: When the headcount is final, e.g. 'Final headcount Fri at 5:00 PM'

who.description: Member name or id already in this seat, empty when open

lockAt.description: How many people in the chat lock the trip
